correctness.rationale: BLOKS Eq. (7) is the stated H, and (12)–(13) give the inverse of the stated P. Writing C=δE+ρ1_n1_mᵀ gives CᵀC=δ²I+(2δρ+nρ²)J and hence h₀,h₁. Blockwise zero sums, zero-global-sum block constants, and the global constant vector give the three simultaneous SPD eigenpairs and listed multiplicities. To check strict ordering independently, write F(x)=1+(δ+ρx)/(δ+λx). The inequality h₁/h₀>t₁/t₀ is exactly mF(n)>sF(s). For ρ≥λ, F is nondecreasing and m≥2s; for ρ<λ, F(n)>1 and F(s)<2. Also t₁>t₀. The s=1 within-block space is absent; when m=n=s, P=H. Comparing the real all-ones direction with the zero-sum vector having equal-modulus root-of-unity phases by block gives identical Q quadratic forms for any SPD block-diagonal Q and a quotient ratio h₁/h₀. CG takes the degree of the least residual polynomial annihilating the spectral components from a zero start, and full column rank of C makes generic responses possible. At n=8,m=4,s=2,ρ=3/5,λ=1/10 direct substitution gives 1/48,1/4,11/16 with ratio 33; b=(1,2,3,4) has each required component. In the repair the normalized top eigenvalue is 1+(mρ/δ)F(n); its derivative has the sign of ρ−λ and the middle ratio t₁/t₀ is independent of n. Packaged code was read, not executed.
residual_risks: Equal size splits and exact arithmetic, not floating-point iteration/runtime or unequal block performance.

originality.rationale: Pass the exact normalized spectral profile and ordering for the actual BLOKS sketch with distinct equicorrelated nonlandmarks of arbitrary count, including the exact dependence on n. The abstract optimal block-scaling lower bound and the first appearance of a third eigenvalue are not accepted as independent discoveries. The full-center and replicated-center constructions already exhibit the homogeneous three-level mechanism and unchanged conditioning; the repair gives them explicit credit. For the same center Gram and ridge, adding distinct training points changes the normalized profile in general, whereas replication never changes it; the mathematical comparison removes the possible equivalence via scalar replication.

value.rationale: The exact spectral calculation for a standard, normalized, realizable kernel and actual distinct-point Nyström sampling analyzes a case not modeled by copying landmarks. It shows why added off-center training points can alter the largest generalized ratio while the failure to condition better and the extra Krylov step survive uniformly. This is a useful obstruction to interpreting a sketched block inverse as automatically improving the distinct-point normal system, beyond an abstract block scaling lower bound.
residual_risks: Not a statistical, wall-clock or finite-precision recommendation; kernel symmetry is special.
